title: Aerated Australian Shrimp Skewers
description: A cultured and adventurous Australian dish featuring black cardamom pods and a mother-sauce-base, this recipe is low-calorie-friendly and perfect for a special occasion. The combination of flavors and textures creates a unique and exciting culinary experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
In a small bowl, mix together the crushed black cardamom pods, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and ginger.
Brush the mixture onto the shrimp, making sure they are fully coated.
Season the shrimp with salt and pepper.
Grill the shrimp for 8-10 minutes, or until they are pink and fully cooked.
While the shrimp are cooking, heat the mother sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the shrimp are done, serve them with the heated mother sauce.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
